scenario.name: r-cd-model-default
scenario.description: Default provider/model inheritance for continue_delegate tool and bracket/token forms when no override is supplied.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: report your observed provider/model and the nonce only. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Observed child runtime model/provider byte from status/session metadata or child self-report backed by session metadata

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: parent-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Parent/provider model byte used as the inheritance baseline

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when both tool and bracket/token no-override forms produce child sessions whose model/provider matches the parent baseline. This is the contrast row for explicit override rows.
